name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: Hormuz closed; US blockade; strikes paused
summary: Hormuz stays closed and the US blockade holds; Trump pauses strikes and Qatar reports progress in talks on 10 Nov
state: Qatar said on 10 Nov that it saw progress in US–Iran talks after its prime minister met President Trump on 9 Nov, but could not say how close a deal was; it said the Strait of Hormuz remained closed (Euronews). Trump said on 9 Nov the war was militarily effectively over and he would hold off new strikes, while keeping the naval blockade (Euronews; Iran International). Iran's leadership set seven conditions for peace (Business Standard). The closed strait sets the Alert.
for_you: Shipping and energy through the Gulf remain disrupted. Anyone in or travelling to the Gulf region should follow FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: Strait of Hormuz substantially closed (Qatar, 10 Nov) and US naval blockade of Iranian ports in force

sources.title: Euronews — Qatar sees 'progress' in US-Iran talks after White House meeting
Iran International — Trump says Iran war 'effectively over' militarily, but US ready to strike again

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
